A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 21-page versions of the same EEG participant-diversity study. Their text, equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendices A.1–A.11 are readable and directly comparable.

before.justification: V2 reports original model-training and evaluation experiments on TUAB, CAUEEG, and PhysioNet, including data-scaling, augmentation, and pre-training results, plus appendix ablations and controls.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results, including the main-text experiments and the preprocessing ablation and contiguous-subsampling control in Appendices A.6–A.7.

M1.justification: The study framework, TCN/mAtt/LaBraM architectures, augmentations, and training and fine-tuning procedures are unchanged. Replacing 'Euclidian' with 'Euclidean' in Section 3.4 is a spelling edit, not a method revision.

E1.justification: Both versions use TUAB for normality prediction, CAUEEG for normal/MCI/dementia classification, and PhysioNet for sleep staging. Pre-training data coverage and appendix test scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The same TCN, mAtt, and LaBraM models participate in the corresponding comparisons. Augmented versus unaugmented, pre-trained versus from-scratch, and LaBraM-compatible preprocessing comparisons retain the same comparator membership.

E3.justification: Participant-separated splits, participant/segment subsampling grids, preprocessing, accuracy aggregation, learning-rate tuning, and early-stopping settings match. The appendix control experiment also retains its original evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The model analysis in Appendix A.5, preprocessing ablation in A.6, contiguous-subsampling control in A.7, and augmentation/sample-size correlation analysis in A.9 are unchanged. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix A.3 retains the same seed counts, mean and standard-error reporting, paired comparisons, and failed-seed disclosure. Appendix A.7 retains its five-seed control, and Table 2 retains the same significance-testing and Bonferroni qualification.

E6.justification: The numerical entries and plotted results match throughout Figures 2–12 and Table 2, including all appendix results. No accuracy, uncertainty value, correlation, ranking, or qualitative finding is added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains the same hierarchical distribution definitions, empirical and population risks in Equation 1, and generalization-scaling reasoning. No mathematical assumption, derivation, formal result, or proof changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, research questions, and conclusion retain the same scientific scope: task-dependent importance of participant diversity, inconsistent augmentation benefits, and benefits from self-supervised pre-training. The conclusion's grammatical correction does not alter its claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of participant distribution shifts, augmentation effects, architectural differences, and pre-training benefits retain their meaning. Section 6's applicability boundaries, possible shift mechanisms, limitations, and future directions are unchanged.

D1.justification: Sections 3 and Appendices A.1–A.4 retain the same hyperparameters, processing instructions, software dependencies, hardware, runtime estimates, and code/data access information. No reproducibility detail is added or revised.

R1.justification: The same 52 references and their substantive uses are retained. The positioning relative to earlier EEG scaling, augmentation, foundation-model, and learning-theory work is unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized copyedits, including 'Euclidian' to 'Euclidean,' 'wave forms' to 'waveforms,' singular/plural corrections, and replacing 'and highlighting' with ', highlighting' in the conclusion. The arXiv stamp updates, while section organization and narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 5's caption capitalizes the sentence beginning 'Pre-training,' and several edited passages have slight line reflow. All graphics, table structures, axes, legends, and figure/table placements remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V3 corrects spelling, agreement, capitalization, and the conclusion's awkward 'and highlighting' construction. These provide slight editorial polish to already understandable passages. The scientific argument, supporting evidence, limitations, reproducibility information, and appendices remain unchanged, so the overall quality difference is negligible.
